records.issue_text: Non-daemon reader thread in GroupTest spins forever if the delete loop throws, since deletedAll is never set, hanging the test suite instead of reporting failure
records.rationale: In `GroupTest#createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, a new non-daemon `Thread` is started that loops `while (!deletedAll.get()) { ... }`. The flag `deletedAll.set(true);` is only executed after the deletion loop (`groupUuuids.forEach(groupUuid -> managedRealm.admin().groups().group(groupUuid).remove());`). If any delete call throws (there is no try/finally), the test method will abort before setting `deletedAll` to true, leaving the reader thread spinning indefinitely and potentially hanging the test JVM/suite.
